problems: Cliopatria's 'Serbian Despots' row (1375-1421) is Zeta of the Balšić, not the Serbian Despotate (that is moravian-serbia); dossier slug serbian-despots kept, identity.name 'Zeta (Balšić lordship)'; wikipedia/wikidata left as Cliopatria gives them (Serbian Despotate, Q878319) and probably should become 'Principality of Zeta' / null.

Cliopatria's 'Albanian Principalities' row is a composite of Albanian lordships, Thomas Preljubović's Ioannina land (the same 43 cells become the Despotate of Epirus in 1385) and Marko Mrnjavčević's Prilep land; Marko's lordship has no dossier.
Cliopatria's 1600-1601 'Principality of Moldavia' shape (256,733 km2) is Michael the Brave's whole union; adjusted to the 1595 outline. The Wallachia dossier should carry the union.

Suzerainty of the vassal states (Moldavia under Poland, Ottomans, Russia; Vidin and Zeta under the Ottomans) is not in these ledgers by design (vassal events belong to the suzerain): ottoman-empire (me-10), kingdom-of-poland/house-of-jagiellon, polish-lithuanian-commonwealth and russian-empire dossiers should carry vassal_start/vassal_end with the counterparts principality-of-moldavia, despotate-of-vidin and serbian-despots.

republic-of-venice (eu-13) records Scutari 1396 and Durazzo 1392 with counterpart albanian-principalities; the Scutari cession of 1396 came from serbian-despots (Đurađ II); Venice should also mirror Ulcinj/Bar/Budva 1405, Bar 1412, Shkodër 1418.
